summary: cliArgsFromMCP must emit structured flag values as a single --flag=value token.
reason: Emitting --flag and value as two argv tokens let an MCP caller send a string such as "--db=/path" for a bool flag (which consumes no value): pflag then parsed the value as its own flag, smuggling hidden or blocked flags (--db, --base-url, --config) past the tool schema. Found by the Phase 4.95 security review; reproduced by chmod-ing an arbitrary user file through a read-only tool.
validated_outcome: TestCliArgsFromMCP_NoFlagSmugglingThroughValues passes; existing passthrough tests updated to the --flag=value form.
